purpose: Define UserModule view modules as derived human/UI projections that never become semantic or runtime authority and perform writes only by invoking explicit canonical operations owned elsewhere.

topics.name: UserModule Views
topics.purpose: Define UserModule view modules as derived human/UI projections that never become semantic or runtime authority and perform writes only by invoking explicit canonical operations owned elsewhere.

operations.name: Invoke canonical operation from view
side_effects: only side effects owned by invoked canonical operation

semantics.view_rule: View is UI-only/read projection by default.
semantics.backend_rule: View owns no private semantic backend.
semantics.write_rule: Any user-initiated mutation resolves to an explicit canonical operation and authoritative write target.
semantics.authority_rule: UI visibility or control presence does not grant runtime authority.
semantics.state_rule: Ephemeral presentation state is view state and does not silently become canonical/runtime semantic state.
semantics.projection_rule: View layout, ordering and nesting are projection semantics only.

invariants.rule: UserModule identity, type, lifecycle, bindings and visibility are explicit canonical/runtime semantics.

hard_gates.condition: view implements private backend mutation instead of canonical operation
presentation state silently becomes canonical definition
view ordering/nesting treated as canonical structure
write target inferred from UI placement instead of explicit operation/ref

references.purpose: Writes resolve to authoritative semantic targets.
